rules.title: Tenant Protection Act rent cap
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are capped at 5% plus CPI, with a maximum of 10%.
rules.quoted_span: Housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the housing is a mobilehome.

rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance rent control
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases are limited to the Rent Board's allowable amount (1.6% from March 2026).
rules.quoted_span: tenancies in newly constructed rental units that first obtained a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979

rules.title: Security deposit limit
rules.requirement: A security deposit may not exceed the first month's rent.
rules.quoted_span: a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required
